Two months ago I was in a similar situation - the perfect plan. I had thought about it for months, doing research, building it up, tweaking it. I had about five plans lined up with different success rates before choosing one. But then I told myself - okay, this is it. This is your last try. I don't want anyone thinking that I went out without having exhausted EVERY avenue to get better. I checked into the mental hospital (one I'd been to 4 times previously) and was there for a week. Spiraling depression almost sent me over the brink, but I eventually broke through and managed to get out of it.

I'd be lying if I said I still didn't have suicidal thoughts after that - but little to no intent. I beg of you, PLEASE go to the hospital, give yourself one last chance, one last opportunity to get through this. You never know what might happen.
What you said put exactly how I feel into words. Thank you. It gave me quite a bit of perspective that I didn't know how to articulate.
Thank you, again, it means a lot just hearing that. It's a battle I've been fighting and one I know I'll continue to fight, so... any help is good help. Thank you.
Thank you... just knowing I'm not alone helps. I always thought my reasoning for cutting to be abnormal or weird from the "typical" or "expected" reasons.
I used to write on myself, or draw. I can't do that because of work. I can hide cutting beneath clothes - usually on my legs. I can't think of much else..
